chapter: Jelly Roll Morton and other records
title: Where the Morton sessions were rehearsed and recorded
summary: He made many records he later forgot; rehearsals were at the union hall or places the publisher arranged, and one recording was in a hotel.

bands.name: Jelly Roll Morton's Red Hot Peppers

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology

blocks.x: wonderful ideas, a wonderful drive in all of that that nobody else quite matched. I don't believe anybody else quite matched that drive you had on those Jelly Roll Martin records.

They were wonderful. Yeah, well I made quite a few records with the General. Some of them that I'd never heard because just as I say, he'd have records to make and he'd call me and I'd go down and rehearse with him and make the records and I'd forget about it. He had records out that I didn't know, didn't know about, you know, forgot about. Where did they rehearse? Well we rehearsed it, let's see, where did we rehearse? We had a... I wonder if you went to his home or if you went to a studio or... No, no, no, we had it where, some place they rented, over the local one place... Over the union, that's there. We used to rehearse and then there's some place else... Was that on State Street in those days? State Street, yes, yes, uh-huh. And someplace else we rehearsed because I think Mel was... I don't know where it was... Oh, the publisher, he arranged it. Yes, uh-huh. And he had someplace... I can't think of where it was, no.
Yeah. Um, was that the Victor Studio, was it up on Oak Street or on Washington in those days? I don't remember, I wasn't here those days, I didn't...
Let's see, I think there was one was over north in some hotel we made some recording, but I can't remember...
Must have been up around near where the Drake Hotel or something like that. Somewhere over in there I think it was. Yeah.

Because there was some hotel back over in there, I remember. Yeah, Baby Dodds told me once about where it was, but I forgot where it was. Uh-huh, uh-huh, uh-huh. Yeah, I, I forgot. Uh-huh. But, yeah, it was back over in there somewhere, yeah. Yeah. Mm-hmm.
